strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_body: Kumenya imvugo kuri interineti akenshi birushaho kuba neza kuko bishobora gukoresha uburyo bwa sisitemu cyangwa ububiko bwo kuri murandasi bw'igikoresho. Uburyo butagira interineti bukora nta interineti, ariko ireme rishobora kuba hasi kuko gutunganya bikorerwa kuri telefoni kandi bishingira kuri modeli yatoranyijwe.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_model_mis: Modeli itagira interineti ntirashyirwamo. Gukuramo bizongerwa mu ntambwe y'igice kitagira interineti.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_locked: Igenamiterere ntirishobora guhindurwa igihe kwandika ibyo uvuga bikora. Banza uhagarike kumenya imvugo.
strings.settings_speech_models_button_body: Kuramo kandi ucunge modeli zihindura ijwi inyandiko nta interineti.
strings.settings_speech_models_header_body: Kuramo modeli z'imvugo zo guhindura ijwi inyandiko nta interineti. Modeli zibikwa kuri iki gikoresho kandi zikagenzurwa na SHA-256 mbere yo gushyirwamo.
strings.settings_speech_models_load_failed: Gupakira manifest ya modeli z'imvugo ntibyashobotse. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_no_models: Nta modeli zitagira interineti zashyizwemo. Fungura Moderi z'imvugo zitagira interineti mu Igenamiterere maze ubanze ukuremo modeli.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_h: Kumenya imvugo nta interineti bikora nta muyoboro. Ireme rishingira kuri modeli yatoranyijwe, ubushobozi bwa telefoni n'imiterere ya mikoro. Kugira ngo ubone ibisubizo byiza kurusha ibindi, koresha kumenya imvugo kuri interineti.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_s: Ireme ryo kumenya imvugo nta interineti rishobora kuba hasi kurusha iryo kuri interineti kuko gutunganya bikorerwa kuri telefoni.
strings.geo_alarm_empty_body: Kora impuruza ishingiye ku kwinjira cyangwa gusohoka mu gace watoranyije.
strings.geo_alarm_stage1_body: Muri iyi ntambwe habikwa impuruza z'ahantu, isuzuma na kopi y'ububiko. Uburenganzira bw'aho uri no gutanga geofence nyakuri bizahuzwa mu ntambwe ikurikira.
strings.geo_alarm_transition_enter_or_exit: Iyo winjiye cyangwa usohotse mu gace
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_latitude: Latitude igomba kuba hagati ya -90 na 90.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_longitude: Longitude igomba kuba hagati ya -180 na 180.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_data: Genzura amakuru y'impuruza y'ahantu wongere ugerageze.
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm_body: Ibikorwa byo gukora no guhindura impuruza z'ahantu, kopi y'ububiko, kugarura no gutanga geofence mu gihe kizaza.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Kora cyangwa uhindure impuruza z'ahantu, inyandiko y'ibikorwa izagaragara hano.
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Ibikorwa byose by'isuzuma ry'impuruza y'ahantu byabitswe bizasibwa burundu.
strings.geo_alarm_stage2_body: Uburenganzira bw'aho uri no kwandika geofence byahujwe. Iyo agace kabitswe gakoze, porogaramu yandika isuzuma kandi ikerekana imenyesha. Kuvuga kwuzuye kuzahuzwa mu ntambwe ikurikira.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_package2_body: Kwandika geofence, kugarura nyuma yo gutangiza, receiver y'impinduka, isuzuma no gutanga imenyesha birafunguye.
strings.geo_alarm_reliability_body: Impuruza zishingiye ku hantu zikeneye kugera ku makuru y'aho uri, aho uri inyuma n'imenyesha. Android ishobora gukomeza gutinza ibikorwa bya geofence kugira ngo ibike batiri.
strings.geo_alarm_permission_precise_missing: Hemewe gusa ahagereranyijwe cyangwa nta burenganzira
strings.geo_alarm_permission_background_missing: Emerera buri gihe mu igenamiterere rya porogaramu
strings.geo_alarm_vendor_hint_body: Ku Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI cyangwa HyperOS, emera kandi kwitangiza kandi ukureho imipaka ya batiri kuri ShiftAlarm. Bitabaye ibyo, ibikorwa bya geofence bishobora gutinda.
strings.geo_alarm_stage21_body: Iyi ntambwe yongeraho inzira zihuse z'uburenganzira, inama z'ukwizerwa n'isuzuma rirambuye. Kuvuga kwuzuye kuzahuzwa nyuma yo kwemeza imyitwarire ya geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_ringing_channel_description: Ijwi, kunyeganyega n'imenyesha rya ecran yose by'impuruza y'ahantu
strings.geo_alarm_cooldown_hint_body: Ibikorwa bisubiramo by'impinduka imwe y'impuruza y'ahantu bishobora kwirengagizwa iminota mike kugira ngo impuruza itavuga inshuro nyinshi hafi y'urubibi rw'agace.
strings.geo_alarm_duplicate_protection_body: Uburinzi bwo kudasubiramo: kwinjira cyangwa gusohoka kimwe ntibizongera kuvugisha impuruza mu minota 3. Igikorwa gihabanye kiracyashobora kuyivugisha.

strings.geo_alarm_map_provider_later: Google Maps, Yandex Maps, ibice bya satelite n'ibivanga byateganyirijwe udupaki tuzakurikiraho. Aka gapaki gakoresha OpenStreetMap.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_step_hint: Intera ihinduka kuri buri m 200. Ntarengwa: m 5000.

strings.geo_alarm_map_search_not_found: Aderesi ntiyabonetse. Gerageza gushakisha byuzuye: umujyi, umuhanda na nomero y'inzu.

strings.settings_permissions_alarm_geo_summary_b: Tunganya ukwizerwa kw'impuruza, uburenganzira bw'aho uri ku mpuruza z'ahantu n'igenamiterere rya batiri ahantu hamwe.
strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Impuruza z'ahantu zikeneye uburenganzira bw'aho uri, aho uri neza n'aho uri mu nyuma kugira ngo zikore porogaramu ifunze. Ushobora kubyemerera mu igenamiterere rya porogaramu.

strings.settings_backup_share_body: Kora dosiye ya kopi y'ububiko maze ufungure idirishya rya sisitemu ryo kuyohereza kuri imeyili, porogaramu y'ubutumwa cyangwa ububiko bwo kuri murandasi.

strings.settings_legal_button_body: Fungura amasezerano y'imikoreshereze, politiki y'ibanga, itangazo ryo kutaryozwa n'igitabo cy'umukoresha.
strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Inyandiko ziboneka nta murandasi. Iyo murandasi ihari, ShiftAlarm ishobora gukuramo verisiyo zigezweho kandi igakoresha iziri muri porogaramu nk'izisimbura.
strings.legal_privacy_body: Uko amakuru yo muri porogaramu, isuzuma n'ibikururwa bitunganywa.
strings.legal_disclaimer_body: Imipaka y'ingenzi y'ukwizerwa kw'impuruza, imenyesha na geofence.
strings.legal_help_body: Igitabo gikora nta murandasi cy'imikorere y'ingenzi ya porogaramu.
strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Inyandiko ntiyashoboye gufungurwa. Reba umuyoboro cyangwa wongere ugerageze nyuma.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: ShiftAlarm ihuriza hamwe gahunda z'akazi, impuruza, impuruza z'ahantu, inyandiko, widget n'ibikoresho bya kopi y'ububiko. Ecran nyamukuru yamaze gufunguka inyuma y'iri dirishya ry'igenamiterere.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Fungura inyandiko za porogaramu kandi wemere verisiyo zisabwa. Zisobanura amasezerano y'imikoreshereze, ibanga n'imipaka y'ukwizerwa kw'impuruza, imenyesha n'impuruza z'ahantu.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Uburenganzira ntibukenewe kugira ngo urebe porogaramu, ariko impuruza, ibyibutsa n'impuruza z'ahantu bishingira ku igenamiterere ry'imenyesha, impuruza z'igihe nyacyo, aho uri na batiri.
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Ushobora kurangiza ubu, ukagaruka ku burenganzira nyuma unyuze mu Igenamiterere.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Fungura igitabo cy'umukoresha gikora nta murandasi mu idirishya ryihariye rya mushakisha.
strings.help_training_offer_body: Fungura igitabo cy'umukoresha umenye icyo buri mikorere y'ingenzi ikora, aho iherereye, icyo ukanda n'ibyo ugenzura iyo hari ibidakora nk'uko byitezwe.
strings.help_training_offer_hint: Igitabo gifunguka nk'urupapuro rwihariye rwo kuri iki gikoresho, bityo ushobora guhinduranya hagati yacyo na porogaramu ukurikiza intambwe.
